combined form audit over frictions and smoothing. DATA ONLY: no scene, flag or binding is produced from this file, and nothing here sets
attitude, strain, mend, enmity, tolerated or stance. tools/harem_smoothing_lint.py checks it (roster, tags, seat overrides, indifferent
rows empty, form vocabulary, nearest-three, mechanism and motive-action uniqueness, Arueshalae positive keys, reserved namespaces unused
in Story.json, enGB anchors) and prints the form audit. Source plan: Writer/drafts/sol/review-harem-smoothing/out.md (Sol second pass,
Luna-corrected). Every motive, action, cost and reaction is AUTHORED design, never canon. 'canon' lists enGB keys checked against
enGB.json on 2026-10-02; 'unsupported' lists premises with no direct native evidence that must never become narrator-established canon.
provenance: R = terms recorded in 06 section 1a (<slug>.terms); S = the character spec supplies the terms anchor, 06 field still to
confirm; P = proposed terms, no 06 field yet. Since W0b (ruling D5) every row is R. Ember and Aivu are friendship-only and out of scope.
Save compatibility: ids, mechanisms and reserved ids are append-only. Never rename or renumber; retire a repair with "retired": true.
forms: a performance at the Fool King's court
form_cap_status: Binding census charged; six open build sheets await allocations among the approved spare forms.

reserved.status: PROPOSED names (unimplemented, no producer, no consumer). Seat-woman spellings await the coordinator's namespace confirmation.

contract: Private opportunity with the strained woman and the Commander alone: an ordinary scene() (via _table_scene or scene() with delay), never table_entry(), whose pair-enmity Forbids would hide it.

Requires: trickster, household.table.kept, her verified route eligibility, the specific learned strain event; Forbids: that event's mend, the opportunity's own .attempted latch, and her own closed/dead/dismissed/departed/away states (Relationship='household' inherits none of them).

Explicit Relationship='household'; InteractionHub='household.table' only at the Table. Physical attendance needs a verified venue: Ch3 and Ch5 are the Table chapters; no Ch4 Table visit; Ch6 supplies no new private repair; KING_GONE closes the door.

The outgoing action choice sets .attempted; every success/failure terminal records exactly one outcome; only the successful terminal sets the mend. 'Another time' uses abort=True and sets nothing. Never abort a check choice.
A Commander check result is not a repair result: for duels, a failed Commander defence can be her honest victory; a successful defence never claims she won. DCs below are tuning proposals, not canon.
A failed or refused attempt spends only that opportunity; a later opportunity has its own id and latch, reads the earlier .attempted plus the unmended target, and is charged in the form audit.

Mending sets no attitude, strain, enmity, tolerated or stance and never settles an atrocity, captivity, trust-confession, coup or route-return obligation. The other woman is not present and is never a gate.
Costs spend only the Commander's optional leisure, boast, convenience or favour, never another woman's time, courtship, repair or protected settlement.
Heat is not a currency of repair; if a success develops into intimacy it follows her own register and cuts at the start of explicit acts.

women.motive: Being passed over stings when the Commander seeks her intelligence but spends every free hour elsewhere.

repairs.action: Seek her out with a harmless coded message of the Commander's own devising, then stay while she picks it apart; the visit is not turned into work.
repairs.cost: The Commander gives up an optional evening at court.
repairs.reaction: She keeps the cipher as a joke at the Commander's expense and answers privately and warmer; no leverage over Irabeth, no confession of a household lie.
repairs.distinction: a summons in her trade, not a trail, a bet kept or a ward hour

unsupported: 'Beth' as native diction (mod address only)
specific secrets and cipher

women.motive: She resents always getting the Commander's duty while someone else gets the fun.

repairs.action: Keep a small wager she proposed earlier and pay its embarrassing forfeit in their private evening. The wager must be produced in play before the strain.
repairs.cost: The Commander surrenders the agreed keepsake or wears the forfeit.
repairs.reaction: Teasing satisfaction, not a sermon about reassurance.
repairs.distinction: an established forfeit paid, not a gift, a postponed visit or hearth attendance

unsupported: the earlier wager (needs an authored producer)

women.motive: A cancelled hour repeats the habit of treating her time as endlessly available.

repairs.action: Arrive for the hour she named and take the tedious preparation work she assigns while she finishes with her patients. No patient's safety depends on the choice.
repairs.cost: The Commander's optional leisure and the least glamorous task.
repairs.reaction: Brisk; she notices hands that worked, not rank that promised.
repairs.distinction: her chosen hour kept amid work, not a trail, a forfeit or a hearth

unsupported: ward, patients and postponed life as native facts
the named hour (needs an authored producer)

women.motive: She objects to being fetched only when the Commander wants the dangerous woman.

repairs.action: Ask to join the tracking exercise she already offered and follow her reading of an authored practice trail, without magical shortcuts.
repairs.cost: The easy route and an optional evening indoors. A mistake wastes the opportunity, never her life or romance.
repairs.reaction: She judges practical attention and soldierly competence.
repairs.distinction: following a living hunter's route, not a present or a demanded confession

unsupported: any attack by Forn or a successor (supplies no event)

women.motive: Her hearth is not a refuge visited only when other hearths are cold.

repairs.action: Seek her out while other diversions remain available, stay through her plain meal, and name the existing guests truthfully when she asks.
repairs.cost: Courtly entertainment and the Commander's preferred fare.
repairs.reaction: Ordinary belonging, not an apology feast; no atrocity pardoned.
repairs.distinction: a deliberately chosen hearth, not a scheduled task, a bet or tracks

unsupported: a specific objection to Baphomet's cult
living hearth as native (route-authored)

women.motive: She has seen another woman receive the interesting part of the Commander.

repairs.action: Prepare a private miniature farce whose concealed trick she can catch and improve, and let her direct the final reversal. A private rehearsal: no court audience.
repairs.cost: The Commander sacrifices a clever punchline and becomes its target.
repairs.reaction: She keeps the improved trick; her pleasure is in making it better and crueler, not kinder.
repairs.distinction: she changes the entertainment itself, not a song, an argument or a deployment

unsupported: that she welcomes losing control

women.motive: She dislikes being treated as the beaten remnant while another partner gets the initiative.

repairs.action: At an invited visit, lay a physical concealment trail and let her stalk the Commander by ordinary audible clues and traces deliberately left. No new supernatural sense; no restored eyes; the brand is not a prop.
repairs.cost: The prepared hiding place's advantage and an optional secrecy favour.
repairs.reaction: She enjoys finding the planner, not being pitied. Pair-seat strain uses the couple's joint omission, never Minagho against Chivarro.
repairs.distinction: pursuit restores initiative; no trap turned, hold won or valuation set

unsupported: special tracking senses

women.motive: She objects to another woman's arrangements being praised while her own management is taken for granted.

repairs.action: Bring two competing offers for a harmless household luxury and let her set the acceptable exchange, then buy on her terms. Authored props, never slave transactions.
repairs.cost: The cheaper preferred bargain; she may reject both and name a modest reachable substitute.
repairs.reaction: A proprietor's satisfaction, not a grateful dependent's.
repairs.distinction: she sets a valuation; not a privilege extracted, a forgery caught or a claim won

unsupported: native approval of any purchase or business policy

women.motive: Another partner praised for cleverness makes her feel the Commander still expects a servant's invisible work.

repairs.action: Give her a sealed packet with a deliberately planted forgery and the Commander's genuine guess; she exposes the flaw and destroys the guess if wrong. Honestly presented as a challenge.
repairs.cost: The prepared boast and the packet's later use as a harmless con.
repairs.reaction: She keeps the last word; no ownership claimed, no praise for obedience.
repairs.distinction: physical falsification detected, not a bad argument, a trap or a mispriced good

unsupported: servant history and forgery skill as direct native facts

women.motive: She was passed over when the Commander gave someone else the only attentive audience.

repairs.action: At their private table, ask for the verse she chooses and attempt her accompaniment (a private rehearsal; no court audience).
repairs.cost: The Commander's prepared comic verse and any claim to duet credit.
repairs.reaction: She corrects, replaces or dismisses the accompaniment; musical attention and authorship, never 'the best woman'.
repairs.distinction: she owns melody and billing; no ambush, debate or wager

unsupported: singer identity, authorship practice and billing preference as native facts

women.motive: She dislikes another woman receiving admiration for poise and control.

repairs.action: Offer the Commander as a private fencing opponent under a narrow first-touch rule she can genuinely win; her weapon stays hers.
repairs.cost: If she lands first, a shallow nick and the optional boast of an unmarked evening. An honest Commander win never fabricates hers.
repairs.reaction: She enjoys an elegant victory and the blood it drew; it does not make her safe, redeem her or settle Seelah's friction.
repairs.distinction: precision and elegance, not fairness after disgrace, brute strength or a trap

unsupported: serial killing is not anchored by these keys; crime dialogue needs its own anchors

women.motive: She reads favour as evidence of who commands attention and power.

repairs.action: Let her challenge the Commander to a wrestling hold with an escape condition she chooses; resist honestly. No prisoner or partner is the stake.
repairs.cost: A lost hold costs a bruise and the right to demand her help in the next household amusement.
repairs.reaction: She accepts proven strength or exposes weakness; no invented mercy.
repairs.distinction: strength of the hold, not a fencing score, a nick or a hunt's initiative

unsupported: Table attendance from commitment alone (staged-death return is route-authored)

women.motive: Praise for another partner must not reduce her to the crown again.

repairs.action: Lay out a small tactical wager between the Commander's solution and hers, then play out her deployment; a losing argument never becomes a guaranteed win. Kitrane only after her incognito introduction.
repairs.cost: The Commander's pet plan and the right to boast of it. No soldiers move; no battle or crown changes.
repairs.reaction: Dry amusement and exact correction.
repairs.distinction: tactical judgment wins a private stake, not navigation, disputation or a bout

unsupported: a post-Iz native return
the Kitrane name in a history where the introduction was not played

women.motive: Another partner named brave can reopen her shame.

repairs.action: Take an honest practice bout and let the result stand, including her victory. A Jannah loss spends this attempt; a later opportunity cannot be thrown either, and no Persuasion claims a thrown bout was genuine.
repairs.cost: If she wins, the Commander yields an optional first-place boast.
repairs.reaction: Pride that can still come out in a rush; no claim that the desertion never happened.

women.motive: Being favoured must not mean being commissioned.

repairs.action: Set an authored navigation problem with false landmarks on a chart at the private table and let her correct the Commander's course. No real voyage, crew, cargo or curse is wagered.
repairs.cost: The shortcut; the Commander accepts her slower course in the exercise.
repairs.reaction: She keeps the flawed chart as an instructive joke.
repairs.distinction: a route read under a captain's authority, not troop placement, a thesis or counterfeit

women.motive: Another woman favoured is an advantage she was not offered.

repairs.action: Offer two truthful prices for a small privilege belonging solely to the Commander and let her bargain for the more useful one. No mind-reading contest, no sham resistance.
repairs.cost: An optional personal favour the Commander would prefer to keep.
repairs.reaction: Predatory satisfaction at an advantageous bargain; no coup promised or settled.
repairs.distinction: a negotiated privilege, not a title claimed, a good valued or a trap turned

women.motive: A rival's favour must not make her a relic of a defeated hierarchy.

repairs.action: Present an authored boast of the Commander's right to a harmless trophy; she interrupts, demolishes its grounds and takes it. Her hostile ceremonial idiom, not worship of her father; never a decorous debate chair.
repairs.cost: An optional trophy and its bragging right.

recalling the Ch5 ghost confession in Ch3

women.motive: She resents a decorative compliment when another woman is credited with danger.

repairs.action: Invite her to find and turn a harmless physical trap the Commander prepared for their game; she chooses to spring, expose or leave it armed.
repairs.cost: An escape route within the exercise and the agreed humiliating capture; no new bodily harm.
repairs.reaction: Professional superiority, never proof that captivity is affection.

design_decisions: D1 RESOLVED (coordinator, 2026-10-02): expand 08 section 5 to at least 20 forms and keep the global cap of two. W0b adopted 17 forms (28 total; 08 section 5 holds mechanism, distinction and grounding) and reallocated 16 repair forms, 3 friction forms and packet K1; motives and actions unchanged.

D2 RESOLVED: mutually exclusive variants of one woman charge a form once (the audit dedupes woman + form); a repair marked "retry": true is not charged. Arueshalae's two variants use different forms, so both forms are still charged.
D3 RESOLVED: K2 'an evidence hearing' and K3 'a negotiation' are approved forms (in the vocabulary). Approving a form does not set a packet's approved flag.

D4 Seat-woman strain/mend namespace (minagho_chivarro.harem.strain.<woman>.<other>.<n>, <a>.harem.*.w.<woman>.<n>) needs coordinator confirmation; tirabade has no PAIR_WOMEN entry for woman-specific routing.

D5 RESOLVED (W0b): 06 section 1a now records terms for every route, so the former S/P rows (Wenduag, Jannah, Gesmerha, Targona, Yaniel, Herrax, Eliandra, Terendelev, Elyanka, Iomedae, Melazmera, Nenio) read R with 06 <slug>.terms.

D6 Venue proof per woman (own-house, travelling, remote or epilogue-only partners such as Herrax, Minagho/Chivarro) before any physical Table repair; King-gone and end-of-Ch5 retry windows need an explicit venue.

D7 Suggested DCs (Kaylessa LoreNature 20, Camellia Mobility 22, Wenduag Athletics 24, Jannah Mobility 22, Horzalah Perception 24) are tuning proposals; the check-to-outcome mapping must be specified per build sheet.
